name: Church of Sweden

colors.symbolism: eternal light, the glory and power of God, and God's faithfulness towards humanity
fire, blood and love — the love of God

description: A square gold (yellow) field divided by a red cross throughout, with a gold crown at the crossing — a banner of the arms of the Church of Sweden.
history: A banner of the arms of the Church of Sweden: a gold shield charged with a red cross and a gold crown in the centre. The arms derive from a fourteenth-century coat of arms in Uppsala Cathedral and carry the church's identity in its modern graphic profile; the church has recently adopted a new drawing of them without altering the blazon. The flag is flown at churches and parish buildings, often beside the national flag. The Church of Sweden was Sweden's established state church until 31 December 1999. No adoption date for the flag itself is given in the sources consulted.

features.symbolism: the cross of Christ; red and gold are the Church of Sweden's colours
